verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right banner order (bottle, then centered logo/headline/subcopy, then CTA) with readable text and a sensible hierarchy. Its flaws: a large dead gap between the bottle and the text, the CTA's right end overlapping the green circle, and the yellow circle floating arbitrarily under the CTA. B is cramped: the oversized headline runs into the overlapping circles, the CTA is jammed against the right edge, the subcopy wraps awkwardly onto three ragged lines, and the bottle crowds the top and bottom edges, so the whole layout feels squeezed.
